value.rationale: Equal isolated reproduction products do not determine the sign of joint-mobility invasion risk. A mathematically natural reciprocal-heterogeneity family has a sharp directional bias boundary and an exact, nontrivial continuously adjustable invasion crossing; it separates known generic mobility synergy from precise quantitative mechanism, useful as a comparative-static benchmark for coupled host/vector epidemic models.
